stored.fact: Call is one isolated structured Claude Code request.
Call.MCPConfig, when set, is inline --mcp-config JSON naming the only MCP servers the call may use; AllowedTools then lists the only tools it may call.
Call.Tools lists built-in read-only file tools, confined to a temp dir seeded by Files.
Call.MaxTurns caps the tool loop (--max-turns); 0 = off.
Runner runs one Call and returns the structured_output object.
Result is a finished call: the structured_output plus what Claude Code reported spending.
CLIRunner drives the claude CLI headless with every source of ambient context switched off, so the model sees only the system prompt and the stdin document.
claudeArgs does not use --bare, because --bare forces ANTHROPIC_API_KEY auth and never reads OAuth/keychain, which breaks a subscription login.
For tool calls, --restricted confines Read and Grep to the working dir and drops code-running tools.
Without --restricted, Read opened an absolute path outside cwd under --safe-mode (probed in P274).
--safe-mode is kept off for both tool calls and MCP calls, because it disables --mcp-config servers too (measured in P211).
--strict-mcp-config still keeps every other MCP server out.
CLIRunner.Available reports whether the claude CLI can be found.
CLIRunner.RunResult is Run plus the cost and turn count Claude Code reports.
